sops.title: Nominee updation / addition (CAMS nomination form)
steps: Search "CAMS Nomination Form" on Google and open the nomination form.
Fill it in CAPITAL letters: fund house (e.g. HDFC Mutual Fund), folio number(s) — several folios can go in the same box — and the investor's name as per PAN.

Nominee details: each nominee's name (Mr / Ms), share (one nominee 100%; more than one — ask the client the percentage), date of birth (dd-mm-yyyy, as per proof of identity) and relationship with the applicant (tick the box).
Nominee identity: for a major, tick one ID type and give its number; for a minor, the guardian's. Address as per Aadhaar (a minor's guardian's), with PIN code.
Nominee's mobile and e-mail (a minor's guardian's); the guardian's name if the nominee is under 18.
Tick the boxes if the client wants the nominee's name and percentage printed on the statement of holding.
Take the client's signature(s) / thumb impression as per the mode of holding.
Documents: self-attested PAN and Aadhaar copies; do the OSV (original seen and verified).

sops.title: PAN update / correction
steps: Prepare a request letter to the respective AMC for updation / correction of the PAN.
In it, mention the investor's name, PAN and folio number(s) and the AMC's name; the investor signs it.
Attach a self-attested copy of the PAN card with the signed request letter.
The same documents serve the PAN step of the minor-to-major process.

sops.title: NRI account opening (Anand Rathi)
steps: Log in to the Anand Rathi mailbox Finowise.ar@gmail.com and write to the Anand Rathi team.
To: suchitadandekar@rathi.com, saloneepawar@rathi.com and support.wm@rathi.com. CC: branch management and the team member.
Subject: "For NRI Account opening" — attach the client's documents and send.

Documents: PAN copy; Indian address proof (Aadhaar, passport, voter ID or driving licence); overseas address proof (utility bill, overseas bank statement, passport with the overseas address, or a government-issued ID).
Also: bank proof showing the NRO or NRE status (cancelled cheque, bank statement or passbook front page); passport copy; FATCA TIN document (mention the TIN number and type).

sops.title: NRI onboarding — single holding (NSE MF platform)
steps: Client Master → Create / Edit Client → Create Client.
Fill all mandatory fields and submit — "Client Details Inserted Successfully" appears.
Search the client by name, click the name and Search — the client dashboard opens.
Fill the mandatory fields: NRO / NRE, mode of holding (Single), whose e-mail and mobile they are, occupation, income source, address type and political relations — Submit.
Fill the NRI (overseas) address and the Indian address.
Nominee details: Yes → number of nominees (up to 3 or 10); nominee SOA "Yes", nominee type (minor / major) and relationship with the first holder — Submit.
Bank details: IFSC (bank name, branch and address fill in automatically), account number (cross-check), account holder name as per the cheque, account type NRE / NRO — Submit.
Account registration is done. For the mandate, follow the mandate registration SOP.
Authorization: NSE e-mails the client to activate the UCC; the client completes the OTP validation.

sops.title: NJ E-Wealth MF account onboarding — individual, single holding
steps: Collect the CIF and required documents from the client and verify the details against them (onboarding checkpoints: OneDrive › Mumbai Internal Team).
Check KYC on CVL KRA (cvlkra.com › KYC Inquiry › PAN + captcha). Continue only if KYC is validated as per Aadhaar.
Upload the CIF, documents and the checkpoints list to the client's folder (OneDrive › Mumbai External › Client Documents).
Log in to NJ Partner Desk (partner ID, password, captcha) › Stock Exchange › E-Wealth Account Registration › Create Client.
Account type E-WEALTH MF, number of holders ONE HOLDER › Next.
Applicant details: tax status, PAN, name as per PAN, date of birth › Verify.

Contact details: mobile (as linked to Aadhaar) and e-mail › Next. The client gets authentication links by mail and WhatsApp — tell them NOT to click; they forward the message or a screenshot. Open the link in Chrome › Next › enter the OTP (the mobile shows verified).
Mobile and e-mail declaration (Self, Spouse, Sister…) and father's or spouse's name.
Preference declarations as per the CIF (WhatsApp services: Yes) › Next. FATCA: nationality, country / state / city of birth, country of tax residency (India for a resident individual) › Next.
Bank: IFSC and account number › Verify Bank (₹1 is credited to verify). Upload the client's signature (JPG) › Save.
Nominee: name, e-mail, mobile, date of birth, Aadhaar and relation › Next.

Mandate: authentication mode (e-Sign, Aadhaar OTP, net banking, debit card or scan — Aadhaar OTP preferred) and mandate limit › Submit. Scan mandate: download it, the client signs as per bank records, then upload via Partner Desk › Stock Exchange › Pending Scan Mandate.
Mandate status: Partner Desk › Stock Exchange › Mandate Status Report › enter the UCC (from Active EWA on the partner dashboard) › Apply. Once the mandate is approved, transactions can be placed.
